meta.title: The award proposal page: with ntd_required_on_proposal Off — blocked

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ in Master QCS.
Enter the existing award proposal allocation flow.
Open the award proposal page from the awarding screen.
Confirm the award proposal page opened.

args.goal: on the award proposal page, click the control or setting labelled ntd_required_on_proposal and record what opens or changes while the company setting is Off; stop on the resulting screen

steps.note: Explore the setting interaction and capture the resulting buyer-side behavior.
Assert the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid rendering.
